business.name: AI Installed
business.offer_line: Three AI systems running in your business in two weeks, for a fixed price, without anyone on your team learning a new tool.

archetype.label: Prelaunch validation funnel
archetype.voice: Direct and unembarrassed. It is asking for a small commitment to an idea that does not exist yet, so it must be specific about what it is, honest that it is early, and clear about what happens next. No fake scarcity.
archetype.summary: One page that turns an idea into evidence. It states the promise, asks for a name and an email, and counts. Nothing else is built until enough people say they want it.
